The '''Archive''' is an unused name in [[Matcha Flavoured]]. The resource pack's language file defines a map called "Archive Map" (translation key <code>filled_map.house_of_wisdom</code>), but no structure, trade or loot table in the pack uses it.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>

The developer's notes plan several main overworld structures, each giving a [[Sacred texts|sacred text]] that is traded for the map to the next, ending in The End: "Abbey -> ??? -> ???".<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref> The Archive map may belong to one of these structures, but the source does not say so.
